title: LionGuard: Building a Contextualized Moderation Classifier to Tackle Localized Unsafe Content

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the performance (Precision-Recall AUC) of generalist, Western-centric moderation APIs (OpenAI Moderation API, Perspective API, LlamaGuard) on a newly curated dataset of Singlish (Singaporean English creole) forum comments, comparing them against a localized classifier to highlight their performance gap on this low-resource language variant.

Conducting qualitative error analysis to show how Western-centric models fail to recognize and accurately classify culturally specific slang, localized offensive references, and dysphemisms (e.g., 'CECA', 'AMDK') unique to the Singaporean socio-cultural context.
